lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Grande Prairie man charged for child luring and sexual exploitation of young B.C. girl on gaming platform Roblox, Edmonton Journal reports.
The U.S. stock market shook Thursday, but it largely absorbed big swings for Nvidia and oil prices and finished with relatively modest losses, The Associated Press reports.

U.S. envoys met Thursday with Russian President Vladimir Putin in the Kremlin before heading to Ireland for talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy as Washington sought new momentum for its peace efforts, The Associated Press reports.
A widespread outage hit Microsoft platforms including Outlook on Thursday, with many users enco, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
